tagline.en: Six cases from 25 to 10,000 AC, plus a Crazy battle mode.
tagline.id: Enam case dari 25 sampai 10.000 AC, plus mode battle Crazy.

items.en: New cases: Pocket (25 AC), Jackpot (1,000 AC) and Mythic (10,000 AC). Jackpot and Mythic are high risk with a ×50 top item.
items.id: Case baru: Pocket (25 AC), Jackpot (1.000 AC), dan Mythic (10.000 AC). Jackpot dan Mythic berisiko tinggi dengan item teratas ×50.

items.en: Case Battle: up to 5 cases per battle and a Crazy mode where the lowest total wins.
items.id: Case Battle: sampai 5 case per battle dan mode Crazy, yang totalnya terendah menang.

items.en: 12 new item drawings for the jackpot drop table.
items.id: 12 gambar item baru untuk tabel drop jackpot.
